name: Aseprite Lua MCP
description: Runs one agent-written Lua script per call through Aseprite's headless CLI. Because the script is arbitrary code, the execute tool is reviewed. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep execute_aseprite_script on Review: the Lua it runs can write files and call out to the host, not only draw sprites.
Set DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR to a dedicated sprite folder so relative output files stay out of project directories.
